title: Job Application prints its quest one stage a line, as The Greatest Heist does
notes: Job Application's stage lines take The Greatest Heist's layout and its intro line goes. Wording only: no number, keyword, tag or behaviour changes. A fused card carries its ingredients' text in the state, so the two golden games that fuse Job Application (seeds 27 and 129) hash differently and are re-blessed; nothing in them plays differently.

player.title: Quest cards show the stage they are on
text: Quest cards now print only the stage they are on, with its progress; their whole text is still in the card's preview. Job Application's text is laid out stage by stage. Nothing plays differently.
